Markets.title: Global market: Eurozone bond yields steady as oil prices ease, traders assess Iran sanctions
Markets.summary: Eurozone bond yields remained stable as easing oil prices and new U.S. sanctions on Iran were evaluated by traders. Meanwhile, stronger German growth and inflation risks sustained expectations for European Central Bank rate hikes.

Markets.title: Conflict-hit oil supply crisis deepens as nearly half of global output comes from affected countries
Markets.summary: Nearly half of the world's oil supply now comes from conflict-affected countries. Iran, Russia, Ukraine, Libya, and Venezuela produced about 45 million barrels per day in 2025, accounting for over 43% of global output.

Markets.title: 697 days, no new record high: Sensex hits worst two-year return stretch since 2012. Will this end soon?
Markets.summary: India's Sensex has gone 697 days without a new record high, marking its worst two-year return stretch since 2012. However, a potential recovery could be supported by easing foreign institutional investor selling and resilient domestic financial flows.

Markets.title: NSE IPO coming soon: Should investors buy unlisted shares now or wait for the mega issue?
Markets.summary: Investors must decide whether to buy National Stock Exchange unlisted shares currently trading around Rs 2,015 or wait for its anticipated public issue in September. The stock has fluctuated between Rs 1,800 and Rs 2,150 over the past year.

Markets.title: Q1 earnings show resilience, but downside risks still loom. HSBC explains why
Markets.summary: About 70% of Indian companies met or beat HSBC's Q1FY27 earnings estimates, driven by mid- and small-cap firms and financials. However, HSBC warned that elevated commodity prices and fading tax and inventory benefits could cause earnings downgrades in future quarters.

Markets.title: Bernstein cuts PFC, REC target prices as bank competition weighs on loan growth
Markets.summary: Bernstein has reduced its target prices and loan-growth estimates for Power Finance Corporation and REC due to increased competition from banks, slower renewable capacity additions, and better financial health among state-owned DISCOMs. Despite these cuts, the brokerage maintained its Outperform rating on both power sector lenders.

Geo-Political.title: Iran says it is 'fully prepared' to counter widened US economic sanctions
Geo-Political.summary: Iran announced it is fully prepared to counter the latest severe economic sanctions imposed by the United States. Although Washington has described these new measures as an "economic D-Day," Tehran claims it has a specific plan to handle them.

Geo-Political.title: Lockerbie bombing trial postponed days before it was due to start
Geo-Political.summary: The trial of a Libyan man for the Lockerbie bombing has been delayed for a third time. The postponement occurred just three days before the start date after new evidence emerged in the 37-year-old case.

Geo-Political.title: UK drone factories may face attacks from 'unknown sources', says Kremlin adviser
Geo-Political.summary: A Kremlin adviser stated that British drone factories could face attacks from unknown sources. This warning follows the UK's agreement to share blueprints for missile components with Ukraine.

Geo-Political.title: US removes Syria from list of state sponsors of terrorism
Geo-Political.summary: The Trump administration has removed Syria from the US list of state sponsors of terrorism. This decision follows the administration's embrace of Syria's new president, former al-Qaeda linked militant Ahmed al-Sharaa.

Geo-Political.title: French tourist dies in Death Valley after car gets stuck in mud
Geo-Political.summary: A 68-year-old French tourist was found dead in California's Death Valley after his car became stuck in the mud. His body was discovered amid extreme temperatures reaching 116°F (46.6°C).

Geo-Political.title: Kit Harington replaces Nicholas Hoult in HBO's Harry Potter series
Geo-Political.summary: Kit Harington has replaced Nicholas Hoult as Gilderoy Lockhart in HBO's upcoming Harry Potter series. Hoult withdrew from the role due to scheduling conflicts.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has evolved into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated work.

Data & Insights.title: EMT: India secures top rank again in July among EM peers as stock market posts gains
Data & Insights.summary: India ranked first on Mint's Emerging Markets Tracker for July for the third consecutive month. The top ranking was driven by resilient economic performance and strong stock market inflows despite rising inflation.

Data & Insights.title: India leads South Asia’s growth, but China+1 gains remain uncertain: World Bank economist
Data & Insights.summary: World Bank economist Franziska Ohnsorge states that India is leading South Asia's economic growth, though its potential benefits from the China+1 strategy have not yet materialized. She also notes that artificial intelligence presents a greater potential driver for India's future economic growth.

Data & Insights.title: Scott Bessent eying US Treasury cashpile, could use $1 trillion General Account for debt buybacks, says report
Data & Insights.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent plans to use the department's $1 trillion General Account to fund expanded debt buybacks. This strategy would focus on repurchasing higher-yielding, older securities, according to a CNBC report.

Data & Insights.title: India negotiating trade deals with nations, blocs worth $15 trillion GDP: Piyush Goyal
Data & Insights.summary: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal stated that India is negotiating trade agreements with countries and blocs representing a combined GDP of $15 trillion. Goyal is currently visiting Japan with a delegation of over 200 business representatives to enhance bilateral trade and investment.

Data & Insights.title: Iranian rial hits record low of 2.02 million against US dollar amid threat of new Trump sanctions — Here's what we know
Data & Insights.summary: On August 24, the Iranian rial fell 4.5% to a record low of 2.02 million against the US dollar. The currency drop followed US President Donald Trump's announcement of a new "crushing economic operation" against Tehran.

Data & Insights.title: Service producer prices index mixed in Q1; air passenger services surge 32%
Data & Insights.summary: First-quarter service producer prices showed mixed results with 2022-23 as the base year, while air passenger services surged by 32 percent. The government noted that aggregate weights are not assigned because the seven tracked services do not cover the entire sector.

India.title: Supreme Court Notice To 20 Trinamool Rebel MPs. Why Speaker Didn't Get One
India.summary: Abhishek Banerjee has petitioned the Supreme Court to direct Lok Sabha Speaker Om Birla to expeditiously decide on disqualification petitions against 20 rebel Trinamool Congress MPs. The Court issued notices to the rebel MPs regarding the delay, but did not issue a notice to the Speaker.

India.title: Kashmiri Pandit 'Hit List': Omar Abdullah Says Serious, Ex-Top Cop Sees Insider Hand
India.summary: Former Jammu and Kashmir Chief Minister Omar Abdullah described the reported Kashmiri Pandit hit list as a serious threat. Former top cop SP Vaid stated that the government must target the masterminds and the insider leaking sensitive personal data to terrorists.

India.title: Centre Weighs Dope Tests For All Commercial Pilots After Air India Plane Row
India.summary: The Indian government is considering mandatory dope testing for all commercial pilots. This follows an Air India flight from Phuket to Delhi that suddenly dropped 300 feet over Odisha, injuring 20 passengers and four crew members.

India.title: IIT Delhi Sets Up External Panel To Probe Into MSc Physics Student Rishikesh Kumar's Death
India.summary: IIT Delhi has established an external panel to investigate the death of MSc Physics student Rishikesh Kumar. The committee will review existing campus protocols and interview students, faculty, and administrators to make recommendations based on its findings.

India.title: Bihar Public Service Commission Clarifies 70th Civil Services Exam Evaluation Row
India.summary: The Bihar Public Service Commission has clarified its answer sheet evaluation process for the 70th Civil Services Examination. The commission advised candidates not to judge the evaluation procedure based on a few photographed pages circulating online.

India.title: Bihar Cops, Students Clash During March Demanding Cancellation Of Key Exam
India.summary: Bihar police and students clashed during a protest march demanding the cancellation of a key BPSC examination. Opposition leader Tejashwi Yadav wrote to Chief Minister Samrat Choudhary urging him to engage with the protesters and resolve the issue.

General.title: More than 70,000 social and affordable homes to be built across England over 10 years
General.summary: Funding has been granted to Greater Manchester, the West Midlands, West Yorkshire, and London to build more than 70,000 social and affordable homes across England. The initiative includes six billion pounds specifically allocated for housing development in London over a 10-year period.

General.title: Beyond China's humanoid robots, a quieter machine revolution is unfolding
General.summary: China's factories currently employ more than two million industrial robots. These machines are rapidly increasing in number alongside the country's prominent humanoid robot development.

General.title: The grieving family who say the coroners' courts aren't working
General.summary: The death of one man has highlighted growing strains and inefficiencies within the UK's coroner's courts. A grieving family is speaking out to argue that the current coroners' court system is not working properly.

General.title: Moment tornado tears through southern France
General.summary: A tornado ripped through several villages in southern France. The disaster injured more than 40 people and destroyed multiple homes.
